# From specs to Azure Boards

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

When the user asks for startup options, that ask names only `$crav1-spark-to-spec`, `$crav1-ideas-to-spec`, `$crav1-bundle-to-specs`, `$crav1-existing-to-specs`, `$crav1-read-environment`, and `$crav1-fix-bug`.

## First prompt

```text
$crav1-ado-sync
```

## Steps

### Check first

The org and the project come from `docs/environments/marks.md`, or from the Azure DevOps URLs in `docs/system/repos.md`. The command checks that `az` works, including the default install paths, and that the project has the Feature work item type. If `az` fails, it states the issue, suggests a fix such as `az login`, and offers a skip. It does not install `az` and it does not log in.

### Work item homes

Each implementation repo has its own work item home, written in the **Work items go to** column of `docs/system/repos.md` as `ADO: <org>/<project>` (`Jira: <project>` is reserved for later; nothing is built for Jira yet). The specs repo never has one.

The first time a command needs a repo's home, it asks: the ADO project the repo lives in (suggested), any other project `az` can read, **same for all N new repos**, or a typed answer. The cell is written only after that answer, never silently.

### Pick, preview, then send

An `AB#` mention that already exists in a code repo stays as it is.

A change goes into the spec first through `$crav1-add-to-spec`, and the preview is rebuilt from the spec.

The `az` command is not shown.

## What gets written

A spec gets one line in that spec’s `work-item.md`, with the milestone or slice label and its home: `Work item: 52 — October billing (ADO: contoso/orders)`. Older lines without the home are read as the org and project in `docs/environments/marks.md` and get the tag on the next write, without a question. An item with no spec gets a row on `## No spec yet in ADO` in `docs/system/landscape.md`: id, title, and date. When a spec is made later, the id moves into that spec’s `work-item.md`. That file is not committed yet and must be committed. It names `$crav1-finalize-commit` and does not run it.

## After

```text
$crav1-finalize-commit
```

Reference page: [ado-sync](reference/skills/crav1-ado-sync.md)

The run ends as [How a run ends](reference/run-ending.md) says: Run next, never a `Next:` line, `Waiting:` only when a step is blocked, and `Uncommitted:` when files changed and are not committed.

human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.211.0/docs/from-ado-sync-push-features.md
